description: This PHP class defines a data model for claim expense types within the OrangeHRM system's Claim API. It serializes the ExpenseType entity into a structured format suitable for API responses, including schema annotations for documentation. The class uses traits for serialization behavior and sets filters and attribute names corresponding to the entity's properties.
